findings.message: 10 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "GAMIFICATION & STREAK MOTIVATION", "Bronze", "Bronze", "Silver").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.
Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.

findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 12 panel shadow(s) heavy enough to read as floating: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06) 0px 12px 32px -4px | rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06) 0px 12px 32px -4px | rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06) 0px 12px 32px -4px
findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.
One radius for panels, one for controls, full round only for pills and avatars.

findings.message: 16 icons sit in tinted squares or circles in 3 different colours.
findings.fix: This is the commonest tell of a generated dashboard. Drop the tinted square: a KPI is a label and a number; an icon, if it helps, is plain and in the text colour.

findings.message: Only 6% of the figures use tabular numerals.
findings.fix: Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on tables, KPIs and anything that updates, so digits keep their width.
Four series colours at most; prefer one accent and neutrals.

findings.message: Only 2 of 11 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.

findings.message: 4 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 70px in "Pre-Workout Prep Checklist", 57px in "Push-Ups (Drop-Set with 3-1-1 Tempo)", 57px in "Bulgarian Split Squats (Bed Edge)".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Recovery" (2px from the right); "Mobility" (7px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "5 Push · 3 Pull" → 3 lines (5 words, 24px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
